metadata.title: Westchester County Community Profiles

acs.dollar_basis: Nominal 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars as published by ACS
acs.municipality_strategy: 25 city/town county subdivisions plus 20 village Census places; Town of Pelham and Town of Rye are separate overlapping aggregates and must not be summed with constituent village profiles

aggregate_boundaries.source_kind: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line county subdivisions
aggregate_boundaries.note: Separate authoritative legal town boundaries used only as overlays; the 43-feature County GIS base layer is unchanged.

land_use.definition: Assessment parcel property class summarized by calculated parcel acres; records flagged DUP_GEO='Y' are excluded to avoid overlapping duplicate geometry.
land_use.limitations: This is assessed use, not zoning or remote-sensing land cover. Parcel acreage excludes rights-of-way/water and may not equal total municipal land area; mixed-use parcels are represented by their primary assessment class.
land_use.classification: First digit of NYS ORPTS property class (100–900 series).

metadata.commute_universe: Workers 16 years and over (ACS B08301). Mode shares include work from home; they are not peak-period trip shares.

business_patterns.limitation: County totals only; County Business Patterns does not publish municipality-level observations for this dashboard.

cpi.series_name: CPI-U, New York–Newark–Jersey City, all items (1982–84=100)
cpi.limitation: Regional inflation context; not a Westchester-specific price index.

requirements.title: Population and demographics
requirements.note: 2024 ACS 5-year estimates and 90% MOEs for every profile.

requirements.title: Households and occupancy
requirements.note: Occupancy, vacancy, and tenure indicators for every profile.

requirements.title: Housing-unit inventory
requirements.note: ACS structure and County parcel context for every profile.

requirements.title: Residential construction and permits
requirements.note: County-level Census BPS files are available; municipal permit detail still requires an external request.

requirements.title: Housing sales and values
requirements.note: Municipal assessed full-market-value totals from the 2025 ORPTS assessment roll are integrated; recorded sale prices and RP-5217 transfer detail are not.

requirements.title: Condominium/cooperative inventory
requirements.note: 2025 NYS ORPTS assessment-roll parcel counts by municipality are integrated. ORPTS publishes no separate condominium class, so condo and co-op units fall within RPS class 411 (Apartments) and are reported as that broader apartment universe.

requirements.title: Household and family income
requirements.note: ACS income, home-value, rent, poverty, and burden indicators with MOEs.

requirements.title: Employment and unemployment
requirements.note: BLS QCEW is integrated for Westchester County: total covered employment, ownership split, and 20 NAICS private sectors. QCEW publishes at county granularity only; LAUS unemployment is not integrated.

requirements.title: Business and economic activity
requirements.note: County Business Patterns establishments, employees, and payroll are integrated; municipal detail is unavailable.

requirements.title: Major employers
requirements.note: Establishment-level QCEW is confidential; a curated County table is required.

requirements.title: Consumer Price Index
requirements.note: Current BLS New York metro CPI-U series is integrated with year-over-year change.

requirements.title: Transportation infrastructure and service
requirements.note: Resident commute mode and MTA Metro-North GTFS scheduled weekday station frequency are integrated by municipality; road network accessibility and traffic conditions are not.

requirements.title: Municipal and administrative geography
requirements.note: 43 non-overlapping County GIS profiles plus two authoritative town overlays.

requirements.title: Schools and enrollment
requirements.note: NYSED enrollment and County school layers are located; the district–municipality crosswalk is not built.

requirements.title: Land use and development pattern
requirements.note: 2025 County assessment-parcel acreage and NYS ORPTS municipal parcel counts by broad use class are integrated; zoning and land cover are not.

requirements.title: Historical time series and crosswalks
requirements.note: Current geography crosswalk is implemented; historical boundary normalization remains future work.

known_gaps: Municipal building-permit detail is not public in one countywide source.
No public ORPTS or County feed separates condominium and cooperative units from the broader RPS class 411 apartment universe.
Major-employer establishment employment requires a curated County source; QCEW publishes at county granularity and establishment-level microdata are confidential.
CDBG-funded project locations lack a verified public countywide spatial layer.
This prototype does not yet integrate school enrollment, recorded property sales, or historical boundary-normalized trends from GR-04/05/14/16.

Westchester County GIS parcel land-use aggregates and the NYS ORPTS assessment roll are independent sources at different granularities; their municipal parcel counts are not expected to reconcile exactly.
